stories.story_title: AK AFA Council 30 vs federal AI preemption (Great American AI Act)
stories.summary: AFA Council 30 pres LeiLauni Scheideman ADN op-ed June 1 opposing federal preemption of state AI worker protections; Great American AI Act discussion draft June 4 (3-yr preemption of state AI-development law); AFT/AFA-CWA opposition June 4.
stories.why: AK has no enacted AI workplace law; preemption narrows window for state guardrails.
stories.consequence: Aviation/labor: AFA Council 30 window to push SB2 before preemption.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: Frame HEAVILY covered 06-01 and 06-04. Avoid re-lead.

stories.story_title: AFA Alaska-Hawaiian Contract Session 15, no AI governance language as AI Crew Solutions enters UAT
stories.summary: Joint negotiating committee Session 15 Seattle June 2-4 reached TA on Section 37 TDY but no AI provisions (AFA update June 5). May 29 Scheduling Committee recap: AK Airlines entered UAT on AI Crew Solutions vacation-bidding platform, summer 2026 deployment.
stories.why: AK Airlines among largest private employers; gap between AI tool UAT and contract language is labor risk.
stories.consequence: Aviation/labor: window to next session June 30-July 3 to add AI provisions.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: Adjacent to already-covered AI Crew Solutions (06-01). New fact: no AI language in contract.

stories.story_title: H-1B $100K fee closes fall 2026 hiring window for AK school districts
stories.summary: ~570 intl teachers at risk (Bering Strait SD ~40% certified staff); H-1B processing lead time passed for Aug 2026; Murkowski S.4087 stalled; AK Leg May 15 resolution unanswered. Same channel AK tech/university/defense use.
stories.why: Workforce supply shock; same H-1B channel AK tech employers use.
stories.consequence: K-12/tech: $100K barrier prices out smaller employers.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: Out of window, background only. Weak AI tie.
